description: Shared Renovate preset for tyutyutyu repositories (managed by github-manager)

packageRules.description: Wait before proposing a new release (supply chain protection)
Leave the pyproject requires-python constraint alone: it is a project requirement, not a dependency to pin (the interpreter version comes from .python-version)
Do not automerge Python minor version updates
Group all Kotlin Gradle plugins and artifacts with the Kotlin monorepo, also those without a source URL (e.g. org.jetbrains.kotlin.plugin.compose)
